tweets.text:
Sitting with a female engineer friend.

She's showing me her DMs and Twitter experience.

My god. What a shit show.

Is this what people call "free speech" ?

It takes her so much time to mute/block.

"we tore down the silos!"

me: "how is it going?"

"we're swimming in information overload, 100s of emails, 100s of Slacks, no one knows what the hell is going on, and we've basically institutionalized swimming in a huge gill-net of dependencies"

20 things I've learned over the years as a systems (over)thinker ...

(some advice I gave a friend, that may be helpful)
“I am not a code monkey. I solve business problems with code. I need to understand that problem to do that well.” @BryanFinster
